query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName:'Qualcomm'}), (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH a,max(m.meetingNumberInt) AS latestMeetingNumberInt RETURN a.resolutionId,a.content,latestMeetingNumberInt ORDER BY latestMeetingNumberInt DESC,a.resolutionId ASC,a.content ASC LIMIT 10
